sv.title: Lanthandel i Södertälje brann ner
sv.summary: En brand rasade under natten mot söndagen i en lantbruksfastighet i Mölnbo i Södertälje kommun. Ett hus som innehöll en lanthandel gick inte att rädda, utan fick brinna ner.

en.title: Village shop in Södertälje burned down
en.summary: A fire raged during the night to Sunday at an agricultural property in Mölnbo in Södertälje Municipality. A house containing a village shop could not be saved and was left to burn down.
